text.tspan: Every end-of-task evaluation, in units of (score − random) / (1 − random). Rows are training phases, columns are tasks in learning order;
the upper triangle is never evaluated. Ours is seed 2, the one complete run.
Read down a column for one task's fate: ours keeps its columns blue, while fine-tuning and from-scratch bleed to red within a few phases.
